## MainBook Bank Statement Converter (Remote)

MainBook turns a PDF bank or credit-card statement into structured transactions and returns them as Excel, CSV, or JSON. Every conversion is re-added by the service — opening balance plus credits minus debits against the printed closing balance — and rows that could not be read confidently are flagged rather than guessed, so an assistant can report what is verified and what still needs a human. Credit-card statements are handled on their own terms, without inventing a per-row running balance that such statements do not carry. Conversion spends the account's page credits (one page, one credit); reading the balance, listing jobs and fetching a finished job are free. Each request is authenticated with the user's own MainBook account; setup instructions are at https://mainbook.ai/mcp.
